links.outcome: Resident diagnostic accuracy and confidence with vs without a 10-minute LLM tutorial
links.effect: Top-three accuracy 62.5% (55/88) after tutorial vs 44.8% (39/87) LLM without tutorial and 32.2% (28/87) conventional search; tutorial gave higher scores (binary p=0.042, numeric p=0.016) and confidence (p=0.006).
links.quote: The LLM tutorial led to significantly higher performance (binary scores: p = 0.042, numeric scores: p = 0.016) and confidence (p = 0.006) but resulted in no relevant differences in reading times.

links.outcome: Clinician performance with LLM assistance in intended workflow versus conventional search
links.effect: Residents with LLM assistance had higher accuracy (44.8% untrained, 62.5% after tutorial) than conventional internet search (32.2%).
links.quote: This was followed by the LLM-assisted workflow before the tutorial (44.8%; 39/87) and the conventional internet search workflow (32.2%; 28/87).

links.outcome: Frequency of hallucinations in LLM search engine queries
links.effect: Hallucinations were found in 5.1% of LLM queries.
links.quote: Hallucinations were found in 5.1% of LLM queries.
